description:
Review sensitive data in AI prompts and likely credential exposures in public GitHub repositories.

Redaxa checks prompts for sensitive data and offers redaction before sharing with AI tools. On Windows, Pro and Business include focused local reviews of public GitHub repositories. Redaxa prioritizes likely API keys, tokens and credentials, identifies probable providers, groups repeated matches, separates examples from actionable findings and provides masked, redacted reports. Extended history and dependency scanning remains optional. Findings are possible exposures, not proof that a credential is valid or a complete vulnerability audit.
Redaxa 0.4.10 cleans up after the PromptShield name.
- Installing or updating Redaxa removes a leftover "PromptShield" entry from Installed apps when the old PromptShield program is no longer on the computer. A PromptShield installation that still works is left as it is, and no app data is touched.
- The Windows download on the website starts the installer directly.
Windows installers require verified Aurelio Avila publisher signatures, trusted timestamps and compatible updater signatures before publication. Repository matches remain review candidates; no detector can guarantee zero false positives or prove that a credential is active.
